component-o.description-s: 5 A 100 V Schottky barrier rectifier, VF 0.80 V max at 5 A, DO-201AD axial (tape and reel); replaces STPS5H100RL (no longer offered in DO-201AD)

forward_source-o.table-s: Maximum Ratings and Electrical Characteristics: Average Rectified Output Current IO 5.0 A at TL = +80 C (all SB570-SB5100)

dynamic_resistance_source-o.read: raster figure read by eye (log current axis): about 0.51 V at 1 A and 0.70 V at 5 A; (0.70 - 0.51) / 4 A = 48 mOhm over 1-5 A; typical curve, accuracy about +/-15 %

cj_source-o.table-s: Typical Junction Capacitance CJ 400 pF, Note 5: 1.0 MHz, 4.0 V DC reverse
